sessions.title: Initial registry build from ogds-elements v1.0.0-beta.2
findings: ogds-elements is a Lit web-component library (7 components) over @ogds/tokens (USWDS-derived ramps); verified against the installed npm package, not the GitHub clone, so the pin is CI-installable

Tiles are the flattened rendered DOM: shadow-DOM content with slot fallback/story content realized; :host/::slotted/::part selectors transformed mechanically by tools/build-ground-truth.mjs (class names unchanged)

Runtime-injected icon custom properties (alert, accordion, primary-nav, banner, header, task-list-step) are not in the package .css files — enumerated in tools/build-ground-truth.mjs ICON_BLOCKS and resolved to data URIs from package SVGs

Component CSS uses native nesting and @layer ogds.components; alert bundles its own copy of the token palette (base-variables.css, excluded from derivation); banner bundles color/spacing/breakpoint tokens

Upstream defect recorded: ogds-banner's button declares aria-controls="gov-banner-default" but the template omits the matching id on .content — tiles add the id (documented per tile in constraints.limitations)
Upstream defect recorded: ogds-header's menu button declares aria-controls="nav" targeting the mobile-only <dialog id="nav">; static desktop tiles omit the attribute (documented per tile)
task-list counter is computed once on slotchange (no MutationObserver upstream) — recorded as a deliberate tradeoff in the task-list tile
